title: Query record (input socket)
description: One statement an input plug returns from query_history: either one execution, or a pre-aggregated shape (exec_count or user_count set, in which case H0 sums the counts instead of counting the record once). query_text is kept exactly as written and is never flattened. user_name is scrubbed by the core before anything is stored. Unset optional fields are left out.

source.description: Free-text origin label, as the source names it.

plug.description: The plug that supplied the record; set by the core when several plugs feed one run.
